definitions.explanation: The single prison sentence in Japanese criminal law since June 2025, which replaced the two older sentences {懲役|ちょうえき} (imprisonment with labor) and {禁錮|きんこ} (imprisonment without labor). Work and rehabilitation programs are assigned to fit each prisoner.

examples.japanese: {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The unified prison sentence was introduced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拘禁刑|こうきんけい}3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant was sentenced to three years' imprisonment.

examples.japanese: {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{受刑者|じゅけいしゃ}→受刑者：31665_jukeisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立|た}ち{直|なお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Under the new prison sentence, guidance focused on prisoners' rehabilitation is provided.

notes:
News reports give sentences in the form {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (… years' imprisonment), often with ⟦{執行猶予|しっこうゆうよ}→執行猶予：18434_shikkouyuuyo⟧ (suspension of sentence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: a sentence of … years' imprisonment
- {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{求刑|きゅうけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: (of a prosecutor) to seek a prison sentence
- {拘禁刑|こうきんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧: the introduction of the unified prison sentence

WATCH OUT:
- Older texts and news before June 2025 use ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧ or ⟦{禁錮|きんこ}→禁錮：19211_kinko⟧; {拘禁刑|こうきんけい} replaced both
